name: Coding agent loop — explore, plan, code, test, iterate

args.task: Explore the codebase and research the best approach for: $prompt. Find relevant files, existing patterns, and any docs or libraries that apply. Return file paths, key functions, and a recommended approach.

nodes.note: Aiko fills target_file/old_text/new_text from the plan. Approval gate enforced.

args.task: Diagnose the failed check for: $prompt. Read the relevant source. Return only a JSON object with string fields relative_path, old_text, new_text describing one minimal replacement that fixes the failure. Keep the complete JSON under 800 characters; do not include markdown or commentary.

semantic_triggers: write code to solve a programming task
fix a bug in the codebase
implement a feature by writing and testing code
debug a failing script or test
summary: Claude Code-style workflow: subagent explores/researches (isolated context), Aiko plans small steps, writes code, runs it in sandbox, fixes failures, verifies. Tool outputs never enter LLM context in bulk. At most one approval-gated correction is applied per run, followed by one script and test rerun; remaining failures are returned without further retries.
